title: Joe Turner at the Dew Drop and Lil Miss Cornshucks
summary: Turner stayed only weeks at the Dew Drop; Harris recalls Wynonie Harris and recording Cornshucks at the Pelican opening.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Working with Sinatra: bands, Vegas and the Sands

blocks.x: I was going to ask, did Joe Turner work around here or anything much? At the Dew Drop. At the Dew Drop. Every time he was here last year. I know he came in just a little spot job there then. Yeah, I know. I wonder, did he used to live here for a while? No, no, no, no.
He didn't live here. He stayed here for about three or four weeks like that and then he'd leave and go.
I thought he might have been here for a half a year or several months.

Oh, no sir. No sir. He'd be here for about three or four weeks or something like that. Sometimes you have a holdover, you know, and the people like him so much, well, they'd hold him over for another week or something like that. Then you had this boy, Walnut Harris. He'd work under me too at Dew Drop. We had Lil Miss Cornchuck. Remember her? Yeah. We recorded her at the J&M. Yeah. We recorded her. I recorded her the day when I was at the Pelican when we opened up the Pelican. Yeah. That's when Thomas Ridley was singing the band at the Pelican.
